recognize_zh: 低倍率骨髓抽吸抹片細胞量豐富，除了三系造血細胞外，散布許多體積大、細胞質淡藍灰且帶空泡或泡沫狀的組織球（histiocytes），在細胞密集處特別顯眼；組織球數目明顯增加即為骨髓組織球增生。
features: Cellular aspirate with abundant hematopoietic cells and scattered fat spaces
Numerous large histiocytes with abundant pale grey-blue foamy to vacuolated cytoplasm
Histiocytes have small round to oval eccentric nuclei
Background trilineage hematopoiesis including granulocytic, erythroid and lymphoid cells
Low magnification precludes assessment of hemophagocytosis or intracellular organisms
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low power is cellular, with trilineage hematopoiesis and scattered fat spaces. Numerous large histiocytes with abundant pale grey-blue, foamy to vacuolated cytoplasm and small eccentric nuclei are distributed throughout the smear, most conspicuous in cellular areas. Hemophagocytosis, pigment or intracellular organisms cannot be evaluated at this magnification. Findings are consistent with marrow histiocytosis; high-power review for hemophagocytosis and organisms, iron stain and special stains for microorganisms, and clinical correlation (infection, storage disorder, HLH) are recommended.

ddx.vs: HLH requires histiocytes engulfing intact red cells, neutrophils or nucleated cells on high-power review, together with clinical and laboratory criteria.
Gaucher cells have fibrillar crumpled tissue-paper cytoplasm rather than foamy vacuolation and show low glucocerebrosidase activity.
These storage histiocytes have uniform soap-bubble lipid vacuoles or sea-blue granules on high power.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters with high N:C ratio and atypical nuclei, unlike dispersed bland histiocytes.
